# Map data

Generated by `scripts/vendor-map-data.mjs` from [Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/) (public domain) at commit `ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19` of [nvkelso/natural-earth-vector](https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector).

- `world-50m.topojson`: 1:50m countries, lakes, rivers, and state/province lines.
- `world-10m.topojson`: 1:10m countries, lakes, and rivers (75% of vertices kept) for zoomed-in maps.
- `places.tsv`: 1:10m populated places (name, region, country, latitude, longitude, population) for place search.
